text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, a street survey!
Do you know about
"Project L'Arc"?

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
I know them.
They're the girls aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, right?

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
I really hope she does well.
Even if she doesn't take 1st, I hope she makes the board.

text_block_list.name: Woman with Parasol
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I'm watching~!
I'm totally rooting for <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Woman with Parasol
text_block_list.text:
What was it... like a supporter group?
I joined something like that too~

text_block_list.name: TV Program Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, here is our topic for today.
A closer look at Sirius Symboli's success!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
She's amazing, isn't she?
My son and I have been hooked on watching her SS Match videos too!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality B
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of SS Matches,
Satono Diamond lately has been—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Mei.
I wonder whom you will choose.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
From Grandmother, to you.
A letter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I thought you had given up on going overseas.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Interesting things do happen sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Letters, huh...
Granny's always been like that—

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text: “Please, win.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Mei. You are younger than us.
And far less experienced.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Yet we are comrades. All to chase a single dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Hold your ground.
We are definitely taking the world.

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
"Let us share this dream together.
Together, we shall behold the view from the summit."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you still dreaming that dream with me?
That same dream from back then—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu?
Do you have business with the Chairwoman as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, another embodiment of romance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How strange. And here I thought the paths of Mejiro and Symboli had already parted ways.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I thought only Symboli crossed the sea.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Me too, Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Both you and I can aim for the world.
...This possibility is a miracle born from pure excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—On this day, I was heading to the school store
to restock on training equipment."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
An all-night heated debate~!
Are sunglasses necessary for overseas expeditions!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Instead of that junk, go buy a lollipop.
Maybe you'll finally shut up while you're sucking on it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Cafe! I got hold of Tachyon!
Her recommended cooling spray is "Thats"!
On the right shelf!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Ah, here's the ointment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
S-Senpais!
The basket is already full...!
choice_data_list: What's the matter with you two?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~n!
I'm putting together an 'Expedition Essentials Kit'!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Two heads are better than one, but three are best!
It's the ultimate set, gathering all of our
individually recommended goods!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: There are definitely more than three, though.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine! Just go with the vibe~!
Right, Satono?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Cafe-senpai!
Is that the hoof ointment you were talking about earlier, yes?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: Everyone gets along really well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All the seniors are so cheerful
that they don't even give me time to feel down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond happily gazed at
the shopping basket placed by her feet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...These are the things needed for a long-term expedition.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Seems so. When I need it, you'll prepare it for me, right, Satono?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Well if it's the other way around,
you have to prepare it, Nakayama-san!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I am always accepting presents from everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan's on that side too~.
How much is all this gonna cost, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...There are a few pricey items
included as well."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …………Do you also desire the details?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
They all seem like things that will surely be of help...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I gazed at the "Complete Expedition Kit" that they had gathered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There might be something useful
for <chrname> in here too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fufu...
